messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — AcmeHealth invoice INV-20260401 shows a line "Onboarding Pilot Fee" for $9,750. I can't find a signed addendum. Did sales/ops enable this as part of the private-deploy pilot?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-20260401 generated for AcmeHealth. Lines:
- Private Platform Fee (annual): $120,000
- Support (enterprise-plus): $28,500
- Onboarding Pilot Fee: $9,750
Total: $158,250

olivia: We ran a small pricing experiment; there was only an internal note in the deal, no customer-signed SOW. We should not bill the pilot fee without explicit customer signature.

raj: Looking at SFDC: Annex Annex-1021 exists, owner=raj.salesops, internal_status=Approved, experimental_billing=true. That experimental flag appears to have auto-tagged the billing integration. Didn't realize billing would treat it as billable.

mike: That annex was meant to be opt-in for customers. Legal didn't sign the customer-facing addendum. Billing pipeline currently picks up any annex with experimental_billing=true. We need to stop that flow.

marta: From finance: do not recognize revenue. We need to reverse the $9,750 and issue a credit. Who can own the credit memo?

sarah: Proposed steps:
1) Create credit memo CM-20260402 for $9,750 and route for approval.
2) Change billing rule: require `sow_signed=true` (or equivalent signed_addendum flag) before emitting any pilot/onboarding fee lines.
3) Sales to contact Acme and confirm acceptance of Annex-1021; if they sign retroactively we will re-bill with appropriate approvals.
4) Post a memo in the April close: "Pilot fee reversed - pending signed SOW". Use GL 4105 for the credit.

olivia: Escalating to Legal and CS now. I will message Acme to confirm we reversed the charge pending signature and attach Annex-1021 to the thread.

raj: I've unlinked Annex-1021 from the billing integration and created internal ticket BILL-337 to patch the pipeline to respect sow_signed. I've also opened SUP-9010 "Customer notice: pilot fee reversed pending signature" and linked it to the annex.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-20260402 for $9,750 created and placed in approval queue.

mike: Approved CM-20260402. I'll own the RCA and push a gating test in the billing deploy to prevent experimental flags from auto-billing. Will add preflight checks as well.

sarah: Processed the reversal in AR and applied GL 4105. Attached credit CM-20260402 to INV-20260401 and marked the invoice as reconciled in the AR ledger. I'll include the note in the month-close packet.

marta: Good. For audit purposes keep Annex-1021, the customer correspondence, and the billing ticket together. If Acme signs retroactively we'll book a revenue adjustment following accounting guidance — no surprise invoice.

olivia: Noted; I'll close SUP-9010 once Legal confirms.

tom: Quick suggestion — can billing start notifying product owners when experimental_billing flags are set so product can confirm it's billing-safe? We keep missing that handshake.

mike: Great idea. Adding a billing-notify-product webhook to BILL-337 and will include a checklist item in the release notes.

sarah: :white_check_mark: CM applied and AR reconciled. Finance side closed pending customer/Legal update.

marta: Thanks everyone. Closing the loop after Legal confirms and AR posts the reversal.
